{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module ContainerOrch where

import qualified Data.Map.Lazy as Map
import Data.Map.Lazy (Map)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BSC
import Data.Word (Word8, Word32)
import Data.Bits (xor, shiftL, shiftR, (.&.))
import Data.List (foldl')
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Container metadata store with encrypted labels
type ContainerID = BS.ByteString
type EncryptedLabel = BS.ByteString

data ContainerState = Running | Stopped | Paused
  deriving (Show, Eq)

data ContainerEntry = ContainerEntry
  { ceState     :: ContainerState
  , ceImage     :: BS.ByteString
  , ceResources :: ResourceLimit
  , ceLabels    :: Map BS.ByteString BS.ByteString
  } deriving (Show)

data ResourceLimit = ResourceLimit
  { rlCpuShares :: Int
  , rlMemoryMB  :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

-- Registry uses a custom hash map for container lookup by encrypted label
newtype LabelIndex = LabelIndex { unIndex :: Map Word32 [ContainerID] }
  deriving (Show)

-- XOR-based decryption for label lookup (simplified symmetric cipher)
decryptLabel :: BS.ByteString -> EncryptedLabel -> BS.ByteString
decryptLabel key enc = BS.pack $ zipWith xor (BS.unpack enc) (cycle $ BS.unpack key)

-- Hash function for the label index
-- Uses FNV-1a variant for distributing encrypted labels
labelHash :: BS.ByteString -> Word32
labelHash bs = foldl' hashStep 2166136261 (BS.unpack bs)
  where
    hashStep :: Word32 -> Word8 -> Word32
    hashStep h b = let h' = h `xor` fromIntegral b
                   in h' * 16777619

-- Bucket selection: maps hash to a fixed number of buckets
-- This determines collision behavior
bucketFor :: Word32 -> Word32
bucketFor h = h .&. 0xF  -- 16 buckets only

emptyIndex :: LabelIndex
emptyIndex = LabelIndex Map.empty

insertLabel :: EncryptedLabel -> ContainerID -> BS.ByteString -> LabelIndex -> LabelIndex
insertLabel encLabel cid key (LabelIndex m) =
  let plainLabel = decryptLabel key encLabel
      h = labelHash plainLabel
      bucket = bucketFor h
      existing = Map.findWithDefault [] bucket m
  in LabelIndex (Map.insert bucket (cid : existing) m)

lookupByLabel :: EncryptedLabel -> BS.ByteString -> LabelIndex -> [ContainerID]
lookupByLabel encLabel key (LabelIndex m) =
  let plainLabel = decryptLabel key encLabel
      h = labelHash plainLabel
      bucket = bucketFor h
  in Map.findWithDefault [] bucket m

-- Container registry with encrypted storage backend
data Registry = Registry
  { regContainers :: Map ContainerID ContainerEntry
  , regLabelIndex :: LabelIndex
  , regEncKey     :: BS.ByteString
  }

newRegistry :: BS.ByteString -> Registry
newRegistry key = Registry Map.empty emptyIndex key

registerContainer :: ContainerID -> ContainerEntry -> [(EncryptedLabel, BS.ByteString)] -> Registry -> Registry
registerContainer cid entry encLabels reg =
  let containers' = Map.insert cid entry (regContainers reg)
      key = regEncKey reg
      index' = foldl' (\idx (encL, _rawL) -> insertLabel encL cid key idx)
                      (regLabelIndex reg)
                      encLabels
  in reg { regContainers = containers', regLabelIndex = index' }

-- Query containers by encrypted label - traverses ALL entries in bucket
queryByLabel :: EncryptedLabel -> Registry -> [ContainerEntry]
queryByLabel encLabel reg =
  let key = regEncKey reg
      cids = lookupByLabel encLabel key (regLabelIndex reg)
      -- Linear scan through all container IDs in the bucket
  in map (\cid -> regContainers reg Map.! cid) cids

-- Batch registration endpoint (exposed to orchestration API)
batchRegister :: [(ContainerID, ContainerEntry, [(EncryptedLabel, BS.ByteString)])] -> Registry -> Registry
batchRegister entries reg = foldl' (\r (cid, entry, labels) -> registerContainer cid entry labels r) reg entries

-- Health check: counts containers in a label bucket
healthCheck :: EncryptedLabel -> Registry -> Int
healthCheck encLabel reg =
  let key = regEncKey reg
      cids = lookupByLabel encLabel key (regLabelIndex reg)
  in length cids

-- Orchestration scheduling: finds containers matching label for load balancing
schedule :: EncryptedLabel -> Registry -> Maybe ContainerEntry
schedule encLabel reg =
  case queryByLabel encLabel reg of
    []    -> Nothing
    (x:_) -> Just x

-- Generate adversarial labels that all hash to same bucket
-- An attacker who knows the key can craft encrypted labels
-- that after decryption all map to bucket 0
generateCollisions :: BS.ByteString -> Int -> [BS.ByteString]
generateCollisions key n =
  let candidates = [ BSC.pack (show i ++ "_label") | i <- [0..n*256] ]
      colliding = filter (\lbl -> bucketFor (labelHash lbl) == 0) candidates
  in take n colliding
